ITA-5.50.4 adhyarbudaḥ अध्यर्बुदः
Superimposed tumour
Development of a new tumour at the site of an existing one, or over the site of an old tumour which has been treated and resolved.

ITA-1.9.3.2.7 ādhyātmika आध्यात्मिक
Relating to self
Relating to the soul as the presiding entity over the body.

ādhyātmikarogaḥ आध्यात्मिकरोगः
Intrinsic or endogenous diseases
A disease resulting from affliction of the psyche and body including all psychosomatic diseases.
